name: cyclops-spark
description: Spark, Claude's living presence for the terminal: a small procedural creature drawn only from real Claude Code session events, as half-block cells or kitty/Ghostty pixels.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Spark's temperament of colour. Error is red in every palette. One of: spark, aurora, ember, moon.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The ground Spark is drawn for. 'auto' follows your Claude Code theme (and a plain 'auto' theme there counts as dark). One of: auto, dark, light.

calm.title: Calm
calm.description: No ambient breathing or drift anywhere. Real events still draw.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Soft cues for real events: a long turn landing, an error, a refusal. 'full' adds wake, mend, compaction and a copied reply. Plays on macOS and Linux. One of: off, soft, full.

chimeAfterSeconds.title: Chime after (seconds)
chimeAfterSeconds.description: A turn must run at least this long before its landing is chimed in 'soft' mode, so quick turns stay quiet.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show Spark's glyph and truthful state line in the status line.

murmur.title: Murmur
murmur.description: Quiet sounds while the model really streams: a low hum while it thinks, soft bubbles while it writes. Plays on macOS and Linux.

band.title: Top strip at start
band.description: Show Spark in the short strip above the prompt from the moment a session starts, without typing /spark top. Useful in small terminals.

link.title: Cyclops Link
link.description: Let Spark notice Keeper (Codex) and Prism (Antigravity) working in the same folder, and let them notice her. She shares only her coarse state, her counts of calls and branches, and whom she is calling; never prompts, commands, paths or names. Needs python3. Off by default.
